title: EastWest Dream Run 2026 Clark Review: Runrio's Freeport Series Leg
seo_title: EastWest Dream Run Clark 2026 Review | Philippines Race
meta_description: EastWest Dream Run 2026 Clark: August 30 at Filinvest Mimosa, Clark. Runrio-produced bank-branded race with registration open on the freeport's fast roads.
dek: Set for 30 August 2026 at Filinvest Mimosa in Clark, this Runrio-produced EastWest Bank race offers four distances with registration open. The Clark leg on the freeport's famously wide roads.
verdict: The EastWest Dream Run Clark brings Runrio's production and EastWest Bank's branding to Clark Freeport — one of the Philippines' best running environments with wide, flat, traffic-free roads. Registration is open. Clark's boulevards (legacy of the former US airbase) make for a genuine PB opportunity. August in Pampanga is the wet season — expect warm, humid conditions. For runners wanting a fast-course, bank-backed race in one of the country's premier running venues, this is a strong pick.

sections.heading: Clark: The PB Factory
paragraphs: Clark Freeport's wide, flat boulevards — legacy of the US airbase — provide one of the Philippines' fastest road-running surfaces with minimal traffic. [1] Filinvest Mimosa is a modern development within the freeport. Runrio's production and EastWest branding add professional polish.
